build_requirements: CMake, a working C++17 compiler toolchain, Python and pybind11. The registered 006 binary is usable without rebuilding. New builds require --binary and an immutable matching-source build receipt.
primary_metric: For each original business bag, add finish minus first_planning_attempt_time over its transport legs. Every failed search and retry remains in the clock. EBS storage between legs is excluded. Device passage and any internal elapsed time are included.
mandatory_companion_metrics: canonical_to_first_planning: all delay before the first planning attempt
finish_minus_admission: physical network elapsed, auxiliary only
boundaries: Local adaptive-k scores choose a next hop at physical internal arrival. Safety negotiation may extend to the goal and retains a full fallback certificate.
This is a sequential transaction simulation; it does not measure real network communication latency or concurrent distributed deployment.
All unfinished segments remain in the denominator. Full-population THT is unavailable until all businesses complete with first-attempt telemetry.
Faults, empty-tray circulation and checkpoint restoration are outside this execution model.
The legacy G31 model and its archived requests remain separately reproducible. The continuous physical model is the default; this registration does not claim a performance winner.

The former activation-ordered 004 runs are diagnostic and do not establish matched nominal-FIFO performance. Registered006 controls use canonical source FIFO and are not promoted as a performance winner.

006 adds a route-excess relaxation rate defaulting to zero, measured from the immutable first source planning attempt; it changes no wake schedule or in-route fallback bound. Static zero-weight one-hop scores omit unused calendar probes while preserving route choices and logical score budgets.
source_order_contract: Stable nominal-release FIFO per source, including a not-yet-ready EBS head. Ties preserve canonical input order. At most one next source attempt per second after the previous successful admission.
